name: Podaxis pistillaris

ecology.substrate: sandy soil; termite mounds in Africa (unchecked)
ecology.season: after rare rains; the dry fruit body stands for months (unchecked)

notes: The main hot-desert representative: a stalked puffball. Its link with termite mounds in Africa is reported but unchecked.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): fruits within days of desert rain, so the mycelium must use short wet spells; a guess

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
